entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE towards the network for modifying a PDU session.

entities.name: PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING
entities.description: State where the UE has initiated a PDU session modification procedure and is waiting for a response from the network.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that initiates the PDU session modification procedure.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: Network entity that responds to the PDU session modification procedure.

relations.description: UE initiates the PDU session modification procedure.
Initiating the PDU session modification procedure establishes the PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state.
The PDU SESSION MODIFICATION PENDING state is guarded by waiting for a response from the network.
